# AIHub — EdTech IELTS Open API Platform (llms.txt)

> Single Live Environment (No Sandbox). Every Developer and AI Agent gets an instant Volume-based Free Trial per IELTS API service.

## Base URL
- Live API: https://api.aihub.edu.vn
- OpenAPI Spec: https://api.aihub.edu.vn/openapi.json
- Console: /console/preview

## Authentication
- Single Live Key: `Authorization: Bearer aihub_live_...`
- End-user Signed Identity (recommended for Exam Room & Learner Profile): `X-AIHub-User-Signature: hmac_sha256_...`

## 5 Core IELTS APIs (4 Skills: Writing, Speaking, Reading, Listening)
1. **POST /v1/ielts/questions** (`exam_gen`) — Generate IELTS exam questions with rubric & sample answers.
   - Free Trial: 500 questions | Post-trial: 200 VND / unit
2. **POST /v1/ielts/grade** (`grading_agent`) — Grade 4-skill IELTS submissions (band 0.0–9.0, 4 criteria, coded errors, actionable feedback).
   - Free Trial: 100 grading units | Post-trial: 1,500 VND / unit
   - Unit normalization: Writing = 1.0 unit, Speaking = 1.0 unit / audio minute, Reading/Listening = 0.2 unit
3. **POST /v1/ielts/exercises/personalized** (`personalized_practice`) — Generate targeted practice sets from learner `error_codes[]`.
   - Free Trial: 150 packs | Post-trial: 800 VND / pack
4. **POST /v1/ielts/exam-rooms** (`exam_room`) — Provision Computer-delivered IELTS virtual exam rooms (server timer, tab lock, auto-submit).
   - Free Trial: 20 rooms (up to 30 candidates/room) | Post-trial: 15,000 VND / room
5. **GET /v1/ielts/learners/{id}/profile** (`learner_profile`) — Aggregate 4-skill band history, priority weaknesses, and exam readiness.
   - Free Trial: 200 queries | Post-trial: 300 VND / query

## Transparent Metering HTTP Headers
Every API response includes:
- `X-AIHub-Service`: service code (`exam_gen`, `grading_agent`, etc.)
- `X-AIHub-Plan`: `free_trial` | `prepaid_credit_payg` | `enterprise`
- `X-AIHub-Quota-Remaining`: remaining trial units or `unlimited`
- `X-AIHub-Quota-Limit`: trial unit limit
- `X-AIHub-Request-Id`: idempotent metering event ID

## Conversion & Error Handling
- 70% trial usage: Console banner + email notice
- 90% trial usage: Webhook event `quota.threshold_reached`
- 100% trial usage (without PAYG/Credit): HTTP `402 Payment Required` with JSON `{ "error": "payment_required", "upgrade_url": "..." }`

## MCP Server (AI Agent Integration)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "aihub-ielts": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@aihub/mcp-server"],
      "env": {
        "AIHUB_LIVE_KEY": "aihub_live_...",
        "AIHUB_SPEND_CAP_VND": "2000000"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
